name: Chicken Stir-Fry
description: Quick weeknight stir-fry with peppers, ginger and soy.
steps: Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil until browned, then remove it.
Stir-fry the sliced peppers with the garlic and ginger for 2 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the remaining soy sauce and toss until glossy.
